papers.title: Revisiting Embodied Chain-of-Thought for Generalizable Robot Manipulation
papers.summary: 作者认为 embodied CoT 该怎么用根本没研究清楚,于是构了个迄今最大的具身 CoT 语料(97 万条轨迹/2.26 亿样本),系统性地做了实验。发现 CoT 当推理前缀会累积错误反而拖累,真正有用的是把它当训练期的表征监督。他们的 ERVLA 用 reasoning-dropout 训练,推理时直接出动作,LIBERO-Plus 86.9%、VLABench 53.2%,真机也优于强基线。
papers.original_abstract: Embodied chain-of-thought (CoT) aims to bridge linguistic reasoning and robotic control, but its effective form and integration strategy remain underexplored. In this paper, we revisit embodied CoT for vision-language-action (VLA) models at large scale. We construct the largest embodied CoT corpus to date, comprising 978,743 trajectories, 226.3M samples, and 2592.5 hours of robot data. Through extensive experiments, we find that effective embodied CoT should ground high-level semantic understanding into concrete action guidance, such as end-effector movement descriptions and image-space trajectories, while high-level reasoning alone brings only marginal gains. We further show that explicit CoT does not scale reliably when used as an autoregressive action prefix, as it suffers from compounding inference errors and unstable reasoning-action coupling. To address these limitations, we propose ERVLA, a VLA model that uses embodied CoT as representation-shaping supervision rather than mandatory test-time reasoning. ERVLA is trained with a reasoning-dropout strategy, enabling the model to absorb rich reasoning traces during training while predicting actions directly without CoT decoding during inference. This design improves scalability with increasing pre-training data and avoids autoregressive instability. ERVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO-Plus with an 86.9% success rate and reaches 53.2% success rate on VLABench, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization. In real-robot experiments, ERVLA further outperforms competitive state-of-the-art baselines, especially on tasks requiring semantic disambiguation and long-horizon execution. Code, data, and model checkpoints will be released.

highlights.contribution: 用迄今最大具身 CoT 数据系统厘清 CoT 在 VLA 里的有效形态,提出 ERVLA 在多个 benchmark 拿到 SOTA。
highlights.innovation: 把 CoT 从测试时的自回归动作前缀改成训练期的表征塑形监督,推理时不解码 CoT,既保住 reasoning 效果又消除自回归不稳定。
highlights.method: 构建 978k 轨迹 / 226M 样本的 embodied CoT 语料,用 reasoning-dropout 策略训练 VLA,让模型学到 CoT 隐式表征,推理时直接预测动作,无需 CoT 解码。
highlights.results: LIBERO-Plus 成功率 86.9%(SOTA),VLABench 53.2%,真机长程语义任务上明显超过强基线。

papers.title: PerceptTwin: Semantic Scene Reconstruction for Iterative LLM Planning and Verification
papers.summary: 想让 LLM 规划器在真机执行前先在仿真里验证一遍，但人工搭仿真太贵。PerceptTwin 从机器人感知栈拿到的语义场景出发，自动生成可交互仿真：开放词表物体图 + 3D 资产生成 + affordance 预测 + 常识检查，再用 LLM judge 验证计划是否符合人类偏好。结果让 GPT5 系列规划成功率平均提升约 39%，还能抗 prompt 注入攻击。
papers.original_abstract: Simulation environments are useful for both robot policy learning and planning verification and validation. Traditionally, the process of creating a simulation was onerous. Creating a bespoke simulation environment for each individual environment that a robot would operate in was simply infeasible. In this work, we introduce PerceptTwin, a fully automatic pipeline that constructs interactive simulations directly from semantic scene representations produced by a robot's perception stack. PerceptTwin combines open-vocabulary object maps with 3D asset generation, affordance prediction, and commonsense condition checking. These interactive simulations can be used to validate and refine plans before they are executed on the robot hardware. Borrowing from the AI alignment literature, we also introduce an LLM judge that verifies plan correctness and alignment with human preferences. Experiments show that PerceptTwin feedback allows LLM planners to refine plans, enhance safety, and resist harmful black-box prompting attacks. In our suite of tasks, PerceptTwin improves plan success by an average of approximately 39% for GPT5, GPT5Mini, and GPT5Nano planners. Additionally, PerceptTwin also improves human plan verification by up to 18% on average for plans that fail due to unfilled skill preconditions. Our results demonstrate the potential of open-vocabulary scene simulation from robot perception as a foundation for safer, more reliable robot planning.

highlights.contribution: 提出全自动从感知到可交互仿真的 PerceptTwin 流水线，让 LLM 规划器在执行前先仿真验证并精修计划。
highlights.innovation: 把开放词表场景图、3D 资产合成、affordance 与常识检查整合成一条自动管线，并引入 LLM judge 做对齐评判而不是只看任务成功。
highlights.method: 感知栈输出语义场景 → 自动拼装 3D 资产、预测 affordance、做常识条件检查 → 形成可交互仿真 → LLM 规划器在仿真里执行 → LLM judge 评估并反馈精修。
highlights.results: 在自建任务集上让 GPT5/GPT5Mini/GPT5Nano 的规划成功率平均提升约 39%，对因前置条件未满足导致失败的计划，人类验证准确率平均提升最多 18%。

papers.title: Dive into the Scene: Breaking the Perceptual Bottleneck in Vision-Language Decision Making via Focus Plan Generation
papers.summary: VLM 和 VLA 都受困于「看不准关键物体」的感知瓶颈，作者认为一步到位地聚焦不靠谱，必须先理解场景再逐步聚焦。SceneDiver 先建一张整体场景图打底，再循环「识别—理解—分析」一步步把任务拆细，最后用轻量 adapter 把这种聚焦能力蒸馏给 VLA。在标准具身基准上幻觉显著减少，而且不拖慢实时控制。
papers.original_abstract: In embodied vision-language decision making tasks such as robotic manipulation and navigation, Vision-Language and Vision-Language-Action Models (VLMs & VLAs) are powerful tools with different benefits: VLMs are better at long-term planning, while VLAs are better at reactive control. However, their performance is limited by the same perceptual bottleneck: visual hallucinations arise due to the models' inability to distinguish task-relevant objects from distractors. In principle, accurate identification and focus on critical objects while filtering out irrelevant ones is the key to break this limitation. A straightforward solution is one-step focus: directly attending to essential objects. However, this approach proves ineffective because effective focus inherently requires deep scene understanding. To this end, we propose SceneDiver, a coarse-to-fine focus plan generation method for VLMs leveraging their long-term planning abilities, that first constructs a holistic scene graph to establish initial comprehension, then progressively decomposes the task into simpler sub-problems through an iterative cycle of recognition, understanding, and analysis. To enable reactive control, we also design a lightweight adapter for distilling the deliberate focus ability into VLAs. Evaluations on standard embodied AI benchmarks confirm that our method substantially reduces visual hallucinations for both VLMs and VLAs, while preserving computational efficiency in tasks requiring fast execution. Our code and data are released at: https://future-item.github.io/SceneDiver.

highlights.contribution: 提出 SceneDiver，用粗到细的聚焦规划缓解 VLM/VLA 在具身决策中的视觉幻觉问题。
highlights.innovation: 不再一步到位锁定物体，而是先建场景图再迭代分解任务，并通过 adapter 把规划侧的聚焦能力迁移到反应式 VLA。
highlights.method: 输入图像和指令，VLM 先生成全局场景图，然后循环递进地识别关键物体并拆解子任务形成聚焦计划；再训练一个轻量 adapter，把这种 attention 蒸馏到 VLA 用于实时控制。
highlights.results: 在标准具身 AI 基准上对 VLM 和 VLA 都明显降低视觉幻觉，并保持快速执行所需的计算效率，具体数字未在摘要给出。

papers.title: PHASER: Phase-Aware and Semantic Experience Replay for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary: VLA 模型在持续学习新技能时会严重遗忘旧任务,作者发现用均匀采样的经验回放压根没考虑操作轨迹里关键子技能时间很短的特点。于是他们提出 PHASER,把回放容量按相位均分,再根据遗忘风险动态加权,还配了个无监督的相位切分小工具。在 LIBERO 三个 VLA backbone 上,平均成功率比同预算 ER 最多提 31%,LIBERO-Goal 上达 87.8%。
papers.original_abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved remarkable success in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, deploying these models in open-ended environments requires continuously acquiring novel skills, a process that inevitably triggers severe catastrophic forgetting of previously learned behaviors. While experience replay (ER) serves as a standard mitigating strategy, naive uniform sampling fundamentally misaligns with the temporal characteristics of manipulation trajectories. It systematically under-samples brief but causally critical sub-skills, leading to phase starvation, and completely overlooks the varying degrees of forgetting across historical tasks. To overcome these limitations, we introduce PHASER, an architecture-agnostic continual learning framework. PHASER employs a phase-centric capacity allocation to guarantee equal memory support for all sub-skills, coupled with a multi-modal interference routing strategy that dynamically prioritizes historical phases at high risk of forgetting. Furthermore, to enable fully autonomous lifelong adaptation, we integrate Auto-PC, a lightweight pipeline combining unsupervised action-signal change-point detection with VLM-based semantic verification to extract temporal boundaries without intensive manual supervision. Evaluated across three VLA backbones on LIBERO continual learning suites, PHASER yields substantial empirical improvements, increasing Average Success Rate (ASR) by up to 31% over matched-budget ER and achieving an 87.8% final ASR on the LIBERO-Goal CL setting.

highlights.contribution: 提出一个架构无关的 VLA 持续学习框架,专门解决经验回放里子技能采样不均导致的灾难性遗忘。
highlights.innovation: 把回放容量按相位(子技能)分配,而不是按轨迹/任务均匀采样;再用多模态干扰路由动态优先重放高遗忘风险的历史相位。
highlights.method: Auto-PC 用动作信号变点检测 + VLM 语义验证自动切相位,然后给每个相位等量内存配额,训练时按当前模型对历史相位的遗忘程度路由重放样本,backbone 无关。
highlights.results: 三个 VLA backbone 在 LIBERO 持续学习套件上验证,ASR 较同预算 ER 最高 +31%,LIBERO-Goal 最终成功率 87.8%。

papers.title: SimuScene: Simulation-Ready Compositional 3D Scene Reconstruction from a Single Image
papers.summary: 从单图重建可直接进物理仿真的 3D 场景,以前要么物体悬空要么穿模,后处理布局校正治标不治本。SimuScene 把物理引擎放进重建 loop 里:仿真出问题就反馈成几何修正信号,沿重力轴拉伸或补全 amodal 形状。最后在物理稳定性 / 几何 alignment 上都是 SOTA,还能直接拿去做人形和机械臂的仿真训练环境。
papers.original_abstract: Reconstructing interactive, simulation-ready 3D scenes from a single image is a critical bottleneck for robotic manipulation. While recent single-image lifters recover plausible per-object shapes, composing them yields scenes that collapse under physical simulation due to interpenetrating, hovering, or sinking objects. Existing physics-aware methods address this strictly as a post-hoc layout correction, leaving the underlying geometric errors unresolved. To address this, we introduce SimuScene, a compositional 3D reconstruction pipeline that puts physics in the loop of shape and layout estimation. Rather than using physics merely for layout cleanup, we utilize the physics engine as a diagnostic measurement tool during the generative process itself. By diagnostically simulating reconstructed objects under gravity, we convert penetration and support failures into quantitative correction signals that drive gravity-axis stretching and amodal shape resampling. This physics-informed feedback loop mitigates accumulated reconstruction errors and produces a stable, simulation-ready compositional 3D scene. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on physical stability and geometric alignment benchmarks. We further highlight SimuScene's utility by deploying reconstructed environments in humanoid control and robot-arm manipulation tasks.

highlights.contribution: 提出 SimuScene,首个把物理仿真作为反馈信号嵌入单图组合 3D 重建生成过程的 pipeline。
highlights.innovation: 不再把物理当作 post-hoc 布局清理,而是作为诊断工具:重力下仿真物体的穿模/支撑失败被转成定量修正信号反馈给形状和布局生成。
highlights.method: 单图 → 单物体形状重建 → 用物理引擎在重力下诊断仿真 → 把穿模/沉底误差量化反馈,沿重力轴拉伸+amodal shape 重采样修正几何,循环直到稳定。
highlights.results: 在物理稳定性和几何对齐 benchmark 上达 SOTA;重建场景成功用于人形控制和机械臂操作仿真任务。

papers.title: Partially Observable Adversarial Patch Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models in Robotics
papers.summary: VLA 模型的对抗鲁棒性几乎没人研究,而且现有对抗 patch 攻击都假设能看到整条执行轨迹,不现实。作者提出部分可观测的威胁模型:只用轨迹一小段前缀就生成一个 fixed patch 攻整段。两步走:先用注意力图定位关键区域,再优化 patch 破坏语义 grounding + 增加轨迹曲率。仿真和真机都能造成长程失败。
papers.original_abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are gaining attention in robotics, yet their robustness to adversarial attacks remains largely unexplored. Existing work shows that adversarial patches can mislead VLA-based robots but assumes full access to the entire execution trajectory, an unrealistic requirement in practice. We address this limitation by formulating a partially observable threat model, where the adversary can exploit only a short prefix of the trajectory to generate a fixed patch applied to all subsequent frames. Under this setting, we propose a two-phase framework. First, we localize the patch using the model's attention maps to identify visually critical regions that correspond to the full instruction. Then, we optimize the patch to disrupt the semantic grounding of target objects and increase the curvature of action trajectories, thereby compounding failures in both perception and control. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world robotic environments show that our method sustains adversarial effects under partial observability, inducing long-horizon disruptions and significantly reducing task success rates.

highlights.contribution: 提出部分可观测下的 VLA 对抗 patch 攻击,把鲁棒性研究推到更真实的威胁模型。
highlights.innovation: 去掉「攻击者能看整条轨迹」这个不现实假设,只用前缀帧就能生成在后续帧都生效的固定 patch。
highlights.method: 两阶段:用 VLA 注意力图定位与指令对应的视觉关键区域;再优化 patch 同时破坏目标物体语义 grounding 并增大动作轨迹曲率。
highlights.results: 仿真和真机机器人实验都显示该 patch 在部分可观测下持续生效,显著降低任务成功率,造成长程级联失败。

papers.title: Preference-Calibrated Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary: Human-in-the-loop RL 做机械臂操作时,被人介入的成功轨迹里也含有次优动作,但现有方法对所有 transition 一视同仁,导致 Q 值被高估。作者提出 PACT,用人介入隐含的偏好信号做 credit reassignment,再直接用人的修正动作对齐 policy。五个真机任务平均 +24.5% 成功率,收敛快 1.3 倍。
papers.original_abstract: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HIL-RL) improves sample efficiency in real-robot manipulation through online human intervention. However, successful trajectories may include suboptimal actions that deviate from the desired task-execution path and force human intervention. Existing HIL-RL methods typically apply the consistent credit assignment principle to all transitions, uniformly propagating discounted terminal rewards through suboptimal segments, ignoring the actual contribution of each transition to task success. This overestimates Q-values for critic learning and indirectly misguides actor updates toward suboptimal behavior patterns. To this end, we propose PACT, a Preference-calibrated Actor-Critic Training framework that leverages the implicit preference signals induced by intervention to perform credit reassignment on identified suboptimal segments while directly guiding policy training for unbiased critic-actor learning. Specifically, we first design a progress model that learns from human demonstration and identifies suboptimal segments for credit correction. Then, from the human action and resampled policy action at the intervention state, we build preference pairs to define a counterfactual advantage that penalizes Bellman targets of the identified suboptimal segment, enabling directional credit calibration. Moreover, we directly align the policy with human corrective actions in the bounded mean space, providing an additional signal beyond critic-guided updates. Across five real-robot manipulation tasks, PACT improves the average success rate by 24.5% and achieves 1.3 times faster convergence, thereby improving both RL sample efficiency and performance. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HILRL-A1X-BC05.

highlights.contribution: 提出 PACT 框架,把人介入的偏好信号显式用于 actor-critic 的 credit 校准,提升 HIL-RL 样本效率。
highlights.innovation: 用 progress model 自动识别次优片段,再用「人动作 vs policy 重采样动作」的反事实偏好做定向 credit 校正,而不是给所有 transition 均匀回传奖励。
highlights.method: 训练一个 progress model 识别次优片段;在介入状态用人动作和 policy 动作构成偏好对,定义反事实优势惩罚 Bellman 目标;同时直接在 bounded mean space 对齐 policy 到人的修正动作。
highlights.results: 5 个真机机械臂任务上平均成功率 +24.5%,收敛速度提升 1.3 倍。

papers.title: WorkBenchMark: A LEGO-Based Assembly Benchmark with an Assembly-by-Disassembly Baseline for the Smart Manufacturing League
papers.summary: 作者想搞清楚机器人装配里「低层操作 + 任务级符号推理」这种组合到底现在能不能端到端学出来，于是做了一个基于乐高 Duplo 的装配基准 WorkBenchMark，灵感来自 RoboCup 智能制造联赛。他们提供 400 个任务、四个难度等级，并给了一个开放词汇感知 + 「拆解逆推装配」的规划式 baseline。结果是这个规划 baseline 在所有难度上都打过了一个现代 VLA 方法，顺手说明现阶段 VLA 还搞不定这种长程符号 + 物理约束的活。
papers.original_abstract: We introduceWorkBenchMark, a LEGO Duplo-based robotic assembly benchmark motivated by the RoboCup Smart Manufacturing League. Robotic assembly couples low-level manipulation with task-level symbolic reasoning under physical constraints, a combination that current end-to-end learning methods do not yet solve reliably. The benchmark provides 400 tasks across four complexity tiers. We provide an open-vocabulary perception, Assembly-by-Disassembly baseline solution. Our planning-based pipeline outperforms a modern vision-language-action approach across all tiers. The benchmark, simulation environment, and baseline implementation will be released openly to support the broader robotic assembly community.

highlights.contribution: 提出 LEGO Duplo 机器人装配基准 WorkBenchMark，覆盖 400 任务 4 个难度等级，并开源仿真环境与 baseline，对标 RoboCup 智能制造联赛。
highlights.innovation: 提出「Assembly-by-Disassembly」思路：把装配问题反过来用拆解来推装配顺序，再配上开放词汇感知，作为打 VLA 的强规划 baseline。
highlights.method: 输入是乐高场景的视觉观测和目标结构；用开放词汇感知识别砖块，再走拆解逆推的符号规划生成装配序列，交给低层操作执行；对比一种现代 VLA 端到端方法。
highlights.results: 在全部 4 个难度等级上规划式 baseline 都优于现代 VLA 方法；具体提升幅度摘要未给出数字。基准、仿真、baseline 将全部开源。

papers.title: Static and Dynamic Representations for Tactile Contact-Angle Estimation with Event-Based Sensors
papers.summary: 事件相机做触觉传感能低延迟,但接触角估计该用静态还是动态表征没人比过。作者用 NeuroTac 传感器跑了三种事件流的空间轮廓表示:动态、静态、组合,发现静态表征反而最稳。所有方案 P99 延迟都低于 10ms,静态在连续滚动场景 MAE 0.160°,停止阶段 0.251°。
papers.original_abstract: Event-based tactile sensing offers low-latency signal acquisition for contact-rich robotic interaction. This paper investigates contact-angle estimation using event streams from an event-based tactile sensor (NeuroTac) and compares three event-derived spatial contour representations: a dynamic representation capturing recent event activity, a static representation recovering a more persistent contact state, and their combined representation. Across the evaluated motion scenarios, all representation pipelines exhibited P99 processing latency below 10 ms at all tested sampling intervals, demonstrating their potential for high-frequency event-based tactile angle estimation in robotic manipulation. The static representation consistently achieved marginally better performance than the dynamic and combined representations under scenario-specific training, yielding a mean overall MAE of 0.160° during continuous sensor rolling and a stop-phase mean MAE of 0.251° during randomly inserted motion interruptions. It also exhibited smaller performance fluctuations across speed and indentation depth variations than the other two representations.

highlights.contribution: 首次系统比较事件触觉传感下三种空间轮廓表征对接触角估计的影响。
highlights.innovation: 提出静态/动态/组合三种事件流表征 pipeline 的对比,而不是只用单一动态事件。
highlights.method: 用 NeuroTac 事件触觉传感器采集滚动接触数据,分别构建动态(最近事件活动)、静态(持久接触)、组合三种轮廓表征,送入估计器预测接触角。
highlights.results: 三种方案 P99 延迟都 <10ms;静态表征最优,连续滚动 MAE 0.160°,中断停止阶段 MAE 0.251°,鲁棒性也最好。

papers.title: CLAW: Learning Continuous Latent Action World Models via Adversarial Latent Regularization
papers.summary: 从没有动作标签的视频里同时学世界模型和连续潜动作。CLAW 用对抗式潜空间正则加 diffusion 视频生成，让模型自己挖掘有语义的动作表征，并预测环境如何因这些动作而变。学完后既能做 observation-only 模仿学习，也能在潜空间里规划动作再映射回真实控制。多任务多本体的实验显示动作表征语义清晰，效果优于已有方法。
papers.original_abstract: We introduce CLAW, a fully end-to-end self-supervised framework for learning a world model jointly with continuous latent action representations directly from action-free videos. Our approach leverages adversarial latent regularization and diffusion-based video generation to capture structured and semantically meaningful action representations while modeling rich, predictive environment dynamics, without relying on any action labels or annotations. By simultaneously training the Latent Action Model and world model, CLAW learns to reason about how inferred actions induce environment transitions from visual observations alone. We show that the resulting latent action world model supports both imitation learning from observation and goal-directed planning. In imitation learning, latent actions extracted from raw videos enable behavior cloning. For planning, CLAW generates sequences of latent actions and maps them to executable actions to reach desired goals. Extensive experiments across diverse tasks and embodiments demonstrate that CLAW produces semantically meaningful latent action representations, supports effective action transfer, and enables planning and imitation from observation, outperforming existing methods.

highlights.contribution: 提出 CLAW，端到端自监督地从无动作视频里联合学习世界模型和连续潜动作表征。
highlights.innovation: 把对抗式潜空间正则和 diffusion 视频生成结合起来约束潜动作，让动作既语义清晰又能驱动世界模型预测，全程不需要动作标签。
highlights.method: 输入纯视频，潜动作模型推断每步连续潜动作，世界模型用 diffusion 预测下一帧；对潜动作施加对抗正则保持结构化；下游用潜动作做行为克隆，或在潜空间规划再映射到可执行动作。
highlights.results: 在多任务多本体的模仿和规划任务上,CLAW 学到的潜动作语义清晰、支持动作迁移,并在 imitation-from-observation 和目标驱动规划上超过现有方法，具体数字未给。

papers.title: World Models Meet Language Models: On the Complementarity of Concrete and Abstract Reasoning
papers.summary: World model 能生成具体的视觉 rollout,MLLM 擅长抽象推理,但 rollout 经常视觉合理却任务错误。作者提出「controlled concrete reasoning」,让模型学会什么时候调 world model、怎么验证、怎么整合。方法 PF-OPSD 训练期用真实未来视频做 teacher 监督学生 on-policy 轨迹。两个新 benchmark 上比基线高 10.6% 和 10.9%。
papers.original_abstract: World models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide complementary capabilities for predicting future outcomes from static visual observations. World models can generate concrete visual rollouts of possible futures, while MLLMs can reason abstractly over questions, goals, and rules. However, generated rollouts are stochastic and may be visually plausible but task-incorrect, making it necessary to determine when visual simulation is useful, whether a rollout is credible, and how it should influence the final answer. We formulate this problem as controlled concrete reasoning, where a model learns to invoke, verify, and integrate visual future simulation alongside abstract reasoning. To study this setting, we construct two human-verified benchmarks, VRQABench for controllable spatial lookahead and OpenWorldQA for open-domain physical prediction, and propose Privileged-Future On-Policy Self-Distillation (PF-OPSD). During training, PF-OPSD uses ground-truth future videos and answers only as teacher-side privileged context to evaluate on-policy concrete-reasoning trajectories, while the deployable student never observes true futures at test time. Experimental results show that PF-OPSD outperforms baseline by 10.6% and 10.9% on VRQABench and OpenWorldQA, respectively, while increasing robustness to noisy or conflicting rollouts. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/yczhou001/PF-OPSD.

highlights.contribution: 把 world model 和 MLLM 抽象推理的互补性形式化为可控的具象推理任务,并提出训练方法 PF-OPSD。
highlights.innovation: 用 ground-truth 未来视频作为 privileged 监督评估学生的 on-policy 推理轨迹,学生部署时不需要看真实未来,自蒸馏出鲁棒的具象+抽象混合推理。
highlights.method: 构建 VRQABench 和 OpenWorldQA 两个人工验证 benchmark;训练期教师拿真实未来视频/答案打分学生的 on-policy concrete reasoning 轨迹,做特权 self-distillation。
highlights.results: PF-OPSD 在 VRQABench +10.6%、OpenWorldQA +10.9%,且对噪声/冲突 rollout 更鲁棒。

papers.title: A 3D Isovist World Model -- Revealing a City's Unseen Geometry and Its Emergent Cross-City Signature
papers.summary: 导航该建模的不是城市长什么样,而是 agent 能去哪。作者用 3D isovist(球面可见深度图)建模建筑之间的可走「负空间」,提出预测下一个 isovist 的具身 world model。意外发现:在 Manhattan 和 Paris 共同训练后,城市身份能从时间 latent 线性解码出来——这种「城市签名」是从动力学里涌现出来的,不是外观特征。
papers.original_abstract: Embodied agents that navigate cities rely on world models that predict how their surroundings will change as they move. But for navigation, what matters is not what the buildings look like; it is where the agent can go. Most world models nonetheless predict appearance, learning how a scene looks rather than the space an agent can move through. Those that do target geometry, such as bird's-eye-view occupancy grids, flatten the three-dimensional environment onto a ground plane, discarding the above-ground and multi-level structure that shapes real navigation. What is missing is a predictive target that captures the navigable geometry an agent actually traverses, without photometric entanglement and without collapsing the third dimension. Our key idea is to model the open volume between buildings, the negative space, encoded as a 3D isovist: a spherical visibility-depth map recording the distance to the nearest surface in every direction. We introduce an embodied world model that predicts the next isovist from a short history of past isovists and a movement action. The prediction is formulated as a depth residual so the decoder inherits sharp building edges, trained with self-rollout scheduled sampling to keep corrupted context on the geometry manifold, and equipped with a persistent latent bird's-eye-view spatial map for cross-path consistency. Our central finding is emergent and unexpected: a single city-blind model trained on Manhattan and Paris develops a cross-city spatial signature, with city identity linearly decodable from its temporal latents far above single-frame baselines, so the signature lives in the learned dynamics rather than in appearance. The representation is lightweight, interpretable, and reproducible, offering a geometric substrate for spatial reasoning in embodied AI, robotics, and urban analysis, released with an open dataset and pipeline.

highlights.contribution: 提出基于 3D isovist 的具身 world model,把导航预测目标从外观换成几何可达空间。
highlights.innovation: 用球面可见深度的 isovist 替代外观/BEV 占据,保留 3D 立体结构;意外发现单一城市无关模型涌现出可线性解码的跨城市空间签名。
highlights.method: 用一小段历史 isovist + 移动动作预测下一个 isovist,做 depth residual 形式预测;用 scheduled sampling 自滚动训练,加 BEV latent 持久空间地图保跨路径一致性。
highlights.results: 城市身份可从时间 latent 线性解码,远超单帧 baseline;开源数据集和 pipeline。

papers.title: A Close Look At World Model Recovery In Supervised Fine-Tuned LLM Planners
papers.summary: SFT 让 LLM 能解经典规划问题,但模型是不是真的学到了 world model?作者做了系列可解释性实验探测内部表征和生成能力,结论:SFT 在有效动作序列上能让 LLM 线性编码动作有效性和部分状态谓词,即使输出概率分类不准内部也可能学到;状态空间覆盖越广(比如 random walk 数据)恢复出的 world model 越准。
papers.original_abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) improves end-to-end classical planning in large language models (LLMs), but do these models also learn to represent and reason about the planning problems they are solving? Due to the relative complexity of classical planning problems and the challenge that end-to-end plan generation poses for LLMs, it has been difficult to explore this question. In our work, we devise and perform a series of interpretability experiments that holistically interrogate world model recovery by examining both internal representations and generative capabilities of fine-tuned LLMs. We find that: a) Supervised fine-tuning on valid action sequences enables LLMs to linearly encode action validity and some state predicates. b) Models that struggle to use output probabilities for classifying action validity may still learn internal representations that separate valid from invalid actions. c) Broader state space coverage during fine-tuning, such as from random walk data, yields more accurate recovery of the underlying world model. In summary, this work contributes a recipe for applying interpretability techniques to planning LLMs and generates insights that shed light on open questions about how knowledge is represented in LLMs.

highlights.contribution: 系统探测 SFT 后的 LLM 规划器是否真的内部学到 world model,而不是只能端到端出 plan。
highlights.innovation: 把可解释性技术系统地应用到 planning LLM,联合考察内部线性 probing 和生成能力两侧,给出三条可复现 finding。
highlights.method: 在经典规划任务上 SFT LLM,做线性 probing 测动作有效性/状态谓词,比较概率分类 vs 内部表征,变化训练数据覆盖度(包括 random walk)看 world model 恢复质量。
highlights.results: 发现 SFT 可让 LLM 线性编码动作有效性和部分 state predicates,生成失败时内部仍可能正确;random walk 数据让 world model 恢复更全。

papers.title: UniCanvas: A Diffusion-base Unified Model for Text-in-Image Joint Generation
papers.summary: 统一多模态模型里图文很难兼得：自回归会画但画不清楚，diffusion 画得好却写不对字。UniCanvas 干脆让 diffusion 直接在像素画布上「画字」，把语言当成视觉模式而不是离散 token 输出。这样图和文都在同一张画布上协调生成，作者声称在统一多模态生成上超过之前方法。和具身关系不大但提到 diffusion 是视觉变化的世界模型。
papers.original_abstract: Recent years have seen remarkable progress in unified vision-language models handling both multimodal understanding and generation within a single architecture. While autoregressive VLMs can reason across modalities, they fail to generate high-quality images. In contrast, diffusion models produce photorealistic visuals yet struggle to generate coherent text, making it challenging to develop a single unified model that can seamlessly handle both visual and text generation. Recent advances suggest that language can be effectively embedded within visual representations, allowing models to reason about textual semantics directly from images. To this end, we propose UniCanvas, a first attempt that unifies diffusion models to generate interleaved multimodal contents through text-in-image generation. Diffusion models naturally capture transformations on a shared pixel canvas, which can be viewed as world models of visual change. Instead of producing discrete text tokens, the model learns to represent language as visual patterns inside images, leveraging its inherent multimodal embedding space. This design allows the model to "draw" text naturally within a single pixel canvas during image synthesis, achieving seamless multimodal generation. Experiments demonstrate that UniCanvas improves performance over previous unified models, positioning text-in-image generation with diffusion models as a promising unified multimodal generation paradigm.

highlights.contribution: 提出 UniCanvas，把文本-在-图中作为统一多模态生成范式，让 diffusion 同时画图和写字。
highlights.innovation: 不再走「diffusion 出图 + 自回归出文」的混合路线，而是把语言嵌进视觉表征，让 diffusion 直接在像素画布里渲染文字。
highlights.method: 把 diffusion 模型当作共享像素画布上的世界模型，训练它把文本表示为图像内部的视觉 pattern，从而在一次去噪过程中同时合成图和文。
highlights.results: 在统一多模态生成基准上优于此前 unified 模型，把 text-in-image diffusion 推为有前景的统一生成范式，具体数字未在摘要给出。

papers.title: A Cookbook of 3D Vision: Data, Learning Paradigms, and Application
papers.summary: 一篇 3D 视觉 cookbook 综述,把点云、网格、体素、3D Gaussians 这些表征以及数据采集、数据集设计、监督范式串成一张统一概念图。覆盖了 2D 监督的 3D 学习、隐式神经表示、4D 世界建模等方向，希望帮助读者梳理效率与保真度的权衡。属于综述材料而非新方法。
papers.original_abstract: 3D vision has rapidly evolved, driven by increasingly diverse data representations, learning paradigms, and modeling strategies. Yet the field remains fragmented across representations and benchmarks, making it difficult to develop unified perspectives on efficiency, fidelity, and scalability. This work provides a data-centric taxonomy of 3D vision that connects geometric representations, datasets, learning frameworks, and applications within a single conceptual map. We begin by analysing the principal structural representations of 3D data--point clouds, meshes, voxels, and 3D Gaussians--along with their acquisition pipelines. We then examine how dataset design, benchmark construction, and supervision regimes shape recent advances, spanning 2D-supervised 3D learning, implicit neural representations, and 4D world modeling. Through this integrative lens, we clarify the relationships among representations, learning paradigms, and downstream tasks in reconstruction, generation, and video modeling, offering a consolidated view of emerging trends toward balancing efficiency and fidelity and toward multimodal geometric grounding.

highlights.contribution: 给出一份数据为中心的 3D 视觉分类法,把表征、数据集、学习框架和应用整合在一个概念地图里。
highlights.innovation: 强调以数据视角串联碎片化的 3D 视觉子领域,把 4D 世界建模等新方向也纳入统一坐标系。
highlights.method: 综述梳理,分别分析点云/网格/体素/3D Gaussians 的结构与采集,然后比较 2D 监督的 3D 学习、隐式神经表示和 4D 世界建模等学习范式以及对应任务。
highlights.results: 无实验性结果,提供对效率-保真度权衡和多模态几何 grounding 趋势的综合视角,可作为入门或选题参考。

papers.title: FORGE: Multi-Agent Graduated Exploitation and Detection Engineering
papers.summary: 这篇是安全方向的:漏洞研究里 PoC 生成、优先级排序、检测规则工程三块割裂,各自只报二进制成功失败。作者提出 FORGE 多智能体系统,五个 agent 跑流水线产出分级利用深度(L0-L3),把数据共享给三个社区。在 603 个 CVE 上 67.8% L1+ 利用率,每个 CVE 仅 1.5 美元。和具身 AI 关系不大。
papers.original_abstract: Vulnerability disclosure volumes now far exceed organizational assessment capacity, yet three adjacent research communities (proof-of-concept generation, vulnerability prioritization, and detection rule engineering) operate largely in isolation. Existing automated exploit generation systems report binary pass/fail outcomes, discarding partial progress and producing no signal for the other two communities. This paper presents FORGE, a multi-agent system that bridges these three silos through graduated exploitation depth. Five specialized agents (Intel, Generator, Planner, Exploit, and Detector) execute in a fixed pipeline that (1) generates targeted vulnerable applications from CVE metadata, (2) conducts coached, multi-turn exploitation assessed by an LLM-primary oracle on a four-level taxonomy (L0: no evidence through L3: full compromise), and (3) produces Sigma and Snort detection rules grounded in OpenTelemetry exploitation traces. Graduated depth is the bridging mechanism: deeper exploitation yields richer behavioral traces for detection engineering, while depth data across scoring bands provides ground truth for prioritization validation. A tiered knowledge architecture accumulates intelligence across assessments, transferring build and exploitation experience to subsequent CVEs. Evaluation on 603 CVEs from the CVE-GENIE dataset achieves 67.8% end-to-end L1+ exploitation at USD 1.50 per CVE across eight languages and 187 CWE types. Exploitation rates remain near 68% regardless of EPSS or CVSS band, indicating that pattern-level reachability is orthogonal to metadata-based prioritization. Detection rules from L2+ exploitation achieve significantly higher span-normalized grounding than L1-derived rules (p=0.035), and 93.4% of generated Snort rules produce zero false positives against a synthetic benign corpus.

highlights.contribution: 提出 FORGE 多 agent 流水线,把漏洞 PoC 生成、优先级、检测规则三个孤立任务通过分级利用深度桥接。
highlights.innovation: 用四级 L0-L3 利用 taxonomy 取代二进制成功/失败,让中间进度数据可被另外两个社区复用;分层知识架构在 CVE 之间转移经验。
highlights.method: 五个 agent(Intel/Generator/Planner/Exploit/Detector)固定流水线:从 CVE metadata 生漏洞应用,LLM oracle 多轮评估利用程度,基于 OpenTelemetry trace 生成 Sigma/Snort 检测规则。
highlights.results: 603 CVE 上 L1+ 利用率 67.8%,每 CVE 1.5 美元,93.4% 的 Snort 规则在 benign corpus 上零误报。

papers.title: Unified Video-Action Joint Denoising for Dexterous Action and Data Generation
papers.summary: 现有 world action 模型把视觉动力学先验窄化成「观测条件下未来动作」分布。Donk 把它放宽到 video + 双手 MANO 轨迹的联合分布,语言+初始图+初始手势条件下做去噪 sampling 当 policy;去掉图条件就变成 text-conditioned 数据引擎产成对的 video-action rollout。dexterous 轨迹精度、视频保真和文本动作 rollout 三方面都改善。
papers.original_abstract: Recent world action models leverage video foundation models by aligning broad visual-dynamics priors with executable robot actions. We revisit this alignment from a distributional perspective. Existing formulations typically narrow the aligned prior into an observation-conditioned policy distribution over future actions. In contrast, we keep the distribution broader by modeling the joint space of interaction videos and executable hand trajectories under multiple conditioning regimes. We propose Donk, a unified video-action denoising model for dexterous hands. With language, an initial image, and the initial hand state, Donk samples future videos and bimanual MANO trajectories as an action policy. Without the image condition, the same denoising architecture samples paired video-action rollouts from a text-conditioned distribution, turning the aligned video prior into a data engine. Across action, video, and text-only generation evaluations, Donk improves dexterous trajectory accuracy, preserves strong video fidelity, and produces smooth text-conditioned action rollouts under the same unified training recipe.

highlights.contribution: 提出 Donk 统一 video-action 去噪模型,用同一架构同时支持灵巧手动作策略和数据生成。
highlights.innovation: 把 video-action 对齐当作联合分布,通过条件切换(有/无图、有/无 text)既做 policy 又做数据引擎,而不是只学窄观测条件 policy 分布。
highlights.method: 扩散去噪建模 (video, 双手 MANO 轨迹) 联合分布,条件可包括 language / 初始图 / 初始手状态;同一架构去掉图条件就变成 text→video+action 生成,统一训练 recipe。
highlights.results: 在 dexterous trajectory accuracy、video fidelity、text-only generation 三个评估上都改善,产出平滑 text-conditioned 动作 rollout。

papers.title: MLP Splatting: Object-Centric Neural Fields
papers.summary: 3DGS 高斯太多,不易分解为物体级。MLP-Splatting 用少量空间局部的 MLP primitive 替代,每个 primitive 自己预测 radiance/opacity,仅 RGB 监督下就自发对应到物体或物体部件。可以无 mask 选几个 primitive 就编辑物体;加可选语义蒸馏支持开词表 instant segmentation。内存只要 1/15,渲染快 3 倍。
papers.original_abstract: 3D representations are fundamental to scene rendering, understanding, and interaction. Recent approaches, such as 3D Gaussian Splatting and Neural Radiance Fields, achieve impressive photorealistic novel-view synthesis, but lack the ability to easily decompose scene elements into a few primitives, requiring additional segmentation or grouping for object-level manipulation. We present MLP-Splatting, a method that enables scene decomposition via a few expressive light-field primitives while providing photorealistic novel-view synthesis.   MLP-Splatting models each primitive as an independent compact MLP with localized spatial support that predicts radiance and opacity. In contrast to low-level Gaussian primitives or a single global radiance field, our neural primitives provide greater expressive capacity while remaining spatially localized. Rendering is performed through efficient sparse volumetric compositing over ray-primitive interactions.   Our primitives are supervised using RGB supervision alone, which yields primitives that represent local scene regions often corresponding to objects or object parts, enabling interactive object-level editing without segmentation masks by selecting a handful of primitives. Our method, augmented with optional semantic feature distillation, enables open-vocabulary scene interaction and open-set instant segmentation. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, we achieve substantially lower memory usage (1/15$\times$) and faster rendering (3$\times$), as we show in our experiments compared to semantic 3DGS methods. Project Page: https://shinjeongkim.com/mlp-splatting

highlights.contribution: 提出 MLP-Splatting,以少量空间局部 MLP primitive 实现可分解的光场表示,兼顾照片级 NVS 和物体级编辑。
highlights.innovation: 用空间局部 MLP 替代海量低层高斯或单一全局 NeRF,既保留高表达力又保有空间分组性,RGB 监督就能自发对应到物体/部件。
highlights.method: 每个 primitive 是独立紧凑 MLP,带局部空间支持,预测 radiance/opacity;通过稀疏体积合成做光线-primitive 渲染;可选语义特征蒸馏支持开词表。
highlights.results: 对比 SOTA 语义 3DGS,内存 1/15,渲染 3× 快;无 mask 通过选少量 primitive 即可做物体级编辑和 open-set instant segmentation。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Next-Best-View Optimization for Risk-Averse Planning
papers.summary: 多机器人协同探未知环境时,集中式 NBV 通信开销大、不太可扩展。这篇让每个机器人各自维护一份私有 3DGS 地图,只交换候选视点、轨迹描述和标量 EIG,用 Consensus ADMM 联合最大化沿轨迹的信息增益。同时用 Average Value-at-Risk 对 3DGS 上的碰撞风险建模,既影响 mask 半径又用来打分。Gibson 实验显示通信量降几个数量级,但建图和安全性接近集中式。
papers.original_abstract: Multi-agent Next-Best-View (NBV) selection for safe path planning in uncertain and unknown environments requires informative, safety-aware, and efficient coordination. Centralized approaches rely on sharing raw sensor data or significant communication overhead, resulting in limited scalability. We propose a distributed, risk-aware multi-agent NBV framework in which each robot maintains a private local 3D Gaussian Splatting map and the team jointly maximizes expected information gain (EIG) restricted to masked zones along planned trajectories. The resulting distributed objective is solved by Consensus ADMM (C-ADMM) over a communication graph, with each robot exchanging only candidate viewpoints, planned trajectory descriptors, and scalar EIG contributions. Collision risk along each trajectory is modeled via Average Value-at-Risk (AV@R) over the local 3DGS map and used both to shape the masking radius and to score planned paths. Experiments in Gibson environments at multiple team sizes show that the distributed formulation approaches the centralized baseline in mapping quality and trajectory safety while reducing communication by orders of magnitude.

highlights.contribution: 提出分布式风险感知的多机器人 NBV 框架,只交换少量信息就接近集中式的建图和安全性能。
highlights.innovation: 每个机器人保持私有 3DGS 地图,用 C-ADMM 求解掩码区域内的期望信息增益,并把 AV@R 风险耦合进 mask 半径与轨迹打分。
highlights.method: 输入各机器人的本地 3DGS 地图,产生候选视点和规划轨迹,沿轨迹算 EIG 并用 C-ADMM 跨机器人达成共识,通信只传视点/轨迹描述/标量 EIG;轨迹安全用 AV@R 在 3DGS 上量化并影响掩码与评分。
highlights.results: 在 Gibson 多种团队规模下,分布式方案的建图质量和轨迹安全接近集中式 baseline,同时把通信量降低数个数量级,具体数值未在摘要列出。

papers.title: PersistGS: Differentiable Physics for Object Permanence in 4D Gaussian Splatting
papers.summary: 动态 3DGS 在物体被完全遮挡时光度监督消失,高斯会退化。PersistGS 把可微刚体仿真和 3DGS 耦合,从遮挡前轨迹反推摩擦和速度,再用 SE(3) 仿真把物体高斯在遮挡期间正确摆放——能复现反弹、摩擦减速这种动力学事件。引入 centroid silhouette loss 把位置梯度从外观噪声里分离出来。轨迹误差降 40%,合成场景 PSNR +2.46dB。
papers.original_abstract: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods reconstruct time-varying scenes from synchronized multi-camera video using photometric supervision. When a moving object becomes fully occluded from all training cameras, this supervision vanishes: the Gaussians representing it receive no gradient signal and degrade. Existing approaches to incomplete observations in neural reconstruction rely on learned generative priors that prioritize visual plausibility over physical correctness.   We propose $\textbf{PersistGS}$, a method that restores object permanence during occlusion by coupling differentiable rigid body simulation with 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our approach decomposes the scene into per-object Gaussians and collision meshes, estimates friction and velocity from the observed pre-occlusion trajectory via differentiable simulation, and uses the resulting SE(3) trajectory to position object Gaussians throughout the occlusion period. Because the predicted trajectory satisfies the governing equations of rigid body dynamics, it faithfully captures contact events (bounces, friction-based deceleration, direction changes) that kinematic extrapolation cannot model. We introduce a centroid silhouette loss that isolates positional gradients from appearance noise, yielding 40% lower trajectory error than photometric supervision. We evaluate using cameras withheld from training that observe the object during its occlusion. Experiments on synthetic scenes show that PersistGS outperforms constant velocity extrapolation by +2.46dB PSNR and comes within 0.19dB of a ground-truth trajectory upper bound.

highlights.contribution: 用可微物理仿真恢复 4D 高斯场景中被遮挡物体的「客体永续性」,弥补光度监督缺失。
highlights.innovation: 不依赖生成先验,而是从遮挡前轨迹反推物理参数,用可微 rigid body 仿真填补遮挡期间的位姿,能正确反映碰撞/摩擦等接触事件。
highlights.method: 场景拆成物体高斯和碰撞 mesh,可微仿真估摩擦/速度;遮挡期用 SE(3) 仿真轨迹定位物体高斯;centroid silhouette loss 把位置梯度从外观里隔离出来。
highlights.results: 轨迹误差比光度监督低 40%;合成场景 PSNR 较恒速外推 +2.46dB,接近 GT 轨迹上界 0.19dB 之内。

papers.title: SparseStreet: Sparse Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Street Scene Simulation
papers.summary: 街景 3DGS 高斯太多存储和渲染都吃不消。作者观察到动态目标(车/人)要高保真,静态背景大量冗余,提出 SparseStreet:先用 node-based 可学习剪枝去掉低贡献高斯,等表示稳了再压背景。Waymo 和 nuScenes 上做到 80% 压缩率而质量几乎不掉。
papers.original_abstract: While 3D Gaussian Splatting has shown promising results in street scene reconstruction, existing methods require massive numbers of Gaussian primitives to capture fine details, leading to prohibitive storage costs and slow rendering speeds. We observe that dynamic objects (e.g., vehicles and pedestrians) demand high-fidelity representations to maintain temporal consistency, while static background regions often contain substantial redundancy. Motivated by this, we propose SparseStreet, a general compression framework specifically designed for street scenes. First, we introduce a node-based learnable pruning strategy that systematically removes low-contributing Gaussian primitives while preserving visually critical regions. Second, after the scene representation stabilizes, we apply background compression, further reducing redundancy in static regions. Our method effectively preserves the geometry and appearance of dynamic objects while significantly reducing the total number of Gaussian primitives. Extensive experiments on the Waymo and nuScenes demonstrate that SparseStreet achieves up to 80% compression ratio with minimal quality degradation, enabling resource-efficient, high-fidelity dynamic scene reconstruction. Project website: https://sparsestreet.github.io/.

highlights.contribution: 提出针对街景的 SparseStreet 通用压缩框架,大幅降低 3DGS 存储和渲染开销。
highlights.innovation: 区别对待动态/静态区域:动态保高保真,静态用 node-based 学习剪枝+背景压缩两阶段冗余消除,而不是一刀切剪枝。
highlights.method: 第一阶段 node-based learnable pruning 系统性去掉低贡献高斯;表示稳定后第二阶段对静态背景再做压缩,保动态对象时序一致性。
highlights.results: 在 Waymo 和 nuScenes 上达 80% 压缩率,质量退化极小,渲染速度大幅提升。

papers.title: UnsOcc: 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction in Unstructured Scene via Rendering Fusion
papers.summary: 无结构场景(露天矿)里 3D 语义占据预测难做,稀疏布局让多模态融合失效,长尾更严重。UnsOcc 用渲染做双向监督的 RenderFusion 模块对齐跨模态特征,再用 Gaussian Splatting 把稀疏 3D 预测投到密集 2D 语义图监督长尾类。在自建露天矿数据集和 nuScenes 上都超过 SOTA。
papers.original_abstract: Unstructured scenes present unique challenges for autonomous driving, as irregular obstacles and sparse scene layouts undermine the effectiveness of traditional perception methods such as 3D object detection. 3D semantic occupancy prediction has emerged as a prominent focus due to its ability to provide dense spatial representations by assigning semantic labels to individual voxels in 3D space. However, directly applying 3D semantic occupancy prediction to unstructured scenes remains challenging because scene sparsity hinders effective cross-modal fusion and the more severe long-tail distribution in these scenarios further degrades prediction performance. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we construct a dedicated dataset of unstructured scenes collected from open-pit mines. Based on this, we propose UnsOcc, a multi-modal 3D semantic occupancy prediction framework that improves robustness in unstructured environments. At its core, we introduce a rendering-based fusion module, RenderFusion, which enhances cross-modal feature alignment through bidirectional rendering supervision. Furthermore, we propose GSRefinement, a detail-aware auxiliary supervision method based on Gaussian Splatting that projects sparse 3D occupancy predictions into dense 2D semantic segmentation maps, enabling effective supervision for long-tail categories. Extensive experiments on both the open-pit mine dataset and the nuScenes dataset demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches.

highlights.contribution: 把 3D 语义占据预测扩展到无结构场景(露天矿),并构建专门数据集。
highlights.innovation: RenderFusion 用双向渲染监督做跨模态对齐;GSRefinement 用 GS 把稀疏 3D 占据投影到密集 2D 语义图,从而能监督长尾类。
highlights.method: 多模态(图像/激光)→ RenderFusion 双向渲染对齐 → 3D 占据预测 → GSRefinement 投影到 2D 语义图做辅助监督。
highlights.results: 在自建露天矿数据集和 nuScenes 上都显著超过现有 SOTA。

papers.title: Characterizing Detectability in 3DGS Poisoning: A Stage-wise Benchmark
papers.summary: 3DGS 越来越多被攻击(对象注入、计算放大、水印),但防御和检测几乎没人做。作者发现 3DGS 流水线有多个阶段,毒化信号是阶段相关的——一个阶段的攻击可能在另一个阶段才暴露。他们提出 Poison-3DGS benchmark 做分阶段检测能力评估,发现没有单一阶段最优,后期的训练动态和高斯参数提供早期不可见的强线索。
papers.original_abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has rapidly emerged as a leading representation for real-time novel view synthesis, but recent work shows it is vulnerable to diverse poisoning attacks, including illusory object injection, computation cost amplification, and post hoc model watermarking. Despite this expanding threat surface, existing studies focus mainly on attack success, while defense and detection remain underexplored. From a detection perspective, a key challenge and opportunity arise from the multi-stage nature of the 3DGS reconstruction pipeline, which produces heterogeneous intermediate representations. Forensic signals for detecting poisoning are inherently stage dependent: an attack introduced at one stage may produce signals that emerge only at later stages. This motivates a stage-wise view of detectability that goes beyond single-stage evaluation. We introduce Poison-3DGS, a benchmark for stage-wise characterization of poisoning detection in 3DGS. It exposes stage-specific artifacts, including multi-view images, geometry, training dynamics, and Gaussian parameters, across a diverse set of scenes and attacks. Using it, we conduct a systematic study of detectability across pipeline stages. Our analysis reveals several insights. First, detectability varies significantly across stages, and no single stage consistently dominates across attack types. Second, different attacks exhibit distinct stage-specific forensic signals, so detection effectiveness depends critically on where signals are observed. Third, later-stage signals such as training dynamics and Gaussian parameter statistics provide strong cues not observable at earlier stages. Overall, our work provides a principled benchmark and the first systematic characterization of stage-dependent detectability in 3DGS, offering a foundation for future research on robust and reliable 3DGS systems.

highlights.contribution: 首个 3DGS 毒化攻击的分阶段检测 benchmark,系统刻画检测信号如何随流水线阶段变化。
highlights.innovation: 不再用单阶段评估,而是把多视图图像、几何、训练动态、高斯参数都当作 stage 相关法证信号,系统比较各种攻击在哪一阶段最容易被发现。
highlights.method: 构建 Poison-3DGS benchmark,覆盖多场景多攻击,采集流水线各阶段中间表示;在各阶段分别做检测器评估,统计不同攻击的最佳检测阶段。
highlights.results: 三条 finding:检测能力随阶段差异大;不同攻击各有最佳阶段;后期训练动态与高斯参数统计提供早期看不到的强检测信号。

papers.title: EvoDrive: Pareto Evolution for Safety-Critical Autonomous Driving via Self-Improving LLM Agents
papers.summary: 自动驾驶安全关键场景生成既要对抗性又要真实,以前用手工启发式或者塌缩成单标量优化。EvoDrive 是首个 LLM agentic 进化框架做多目标场景生成:仿真器锚定的 actor-critic 架构,memory-driven actor 提改进、critic 过滤、自进化 world evaluator 路由有希望的候选,并维护 Pareto archive。在 MetaDrive 和 CARLA 上把 Pareto 前沿显著推开。
papers.original_abstract: Generating safety-critical scenarios is essential for validating and improving autonomous driving systems, yet it inherently requires maximizing adversariality to expose failures while preserving realism. Existing methods usually manage this trade-off with handcrafted heuristics, confining generation to known priors and overlooking underexplored patterns. While recent open-ended agentic evolution can push this limit, unconstrained general agents lack strict simulator grounding and tend to collapse the multi-objective tension into single-scalar maximization. Here we present EvoDrive, the first automated, LLM-based agentic evolution framework for multi-objective scenario generation. EvoDrive employs a simulator-grounded actor-critic architecture where a memory-driven actor iteratively proposes improvements to the generators and critics filter out implausible candidates, and a self-evolving world evaluator routes promising proposals to optimize simulation budgets. EvoDrive further maintains a Pareto archive of evaluated candidates to preserve diverse attack-realism trade-offs and guide future evolution via simulation feedback. Benchmark results on MetaDrive and CARLA show that EvoDrive not only significantly expands the Pareto frontier across various generators, but also produces valuable scenarios for policy training.

highlights.contribution: 提出首个 LLM agentic 多目标安全关键场景生成框架 EvoDrive,显式维护对抗性-真实性的 Pareto 前沿。
highlights.innovation: 把单标量最大化换成多目标 Pareto 进化,且 LLM agent 被仿真器严格 grounding;memory-driven actor + self-evolving world evaluator 联动而不是无约束开放 agent。
highlights.method: actor-critic 架构:memory-driven actor 提改进 generators/critics,critic 过滤不合理候选,self-evolving world evaluator 给候选打分并分配仿真预算;Pareto archive 保多样性。
highlights.results: 在 MetaDrive 和 CARLA 多种 generator 上显著扩展 Pareto 前沿,产出场景可用于策略训练。

papers.title: Multi$^2$: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Decision-Making with LLM-Based Agents in Interactive Environments
papers.summary: LLM agent 长程决策容易目标漂移。Multi² 显式分层:高层 agent (System 1) 用 SFT 做上下文感知的子目标生成,低层 agent (System 2) 用 offline-to-online RL 执行原子动作。这样把长程控制稳住,而且 release 了三个新的分层 benchmark 数据集。在多个交互环境里超过强 agentic baseline。
papers.original_abstract: A central goal of large language model (LLM) research is to build agentic systems that can plan, act, and adapt through sustained interaction with dynamic environments. While recent LLM-based agents exhibit impressive contextual reasoning, their long-horizon decision-making remains fragile, often suffering from objective drift, where goals and plans drift over extended interactions. We introduce Multi$^2$, a hierarchical multi-agent decision-making framework that explicitly decomposes agent behavior into complementary roles. A high-level agent (System 1) focuses on context-aware sub-goal generation using supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while a low-level agent (System 2) executes atomic actions through offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) in interactive environments. This separation enables stable long-horizon control, mitigates objective drift, and allows efficient adaptation. Across diverse interactive environments, Multi$^2$ consistently outperforms strong agentic baselines, demonstrating improved robustness and coordination in multi-turn interaction. Beyond performance, we introduce and release three hierarchical benchmark datasets, filling a long-standing gap in training and evaluating hierarchical decision-making for LLM-based agents.

highlights.contribution: 提出 Multi² 分层多 agent 决策框架,显式分离子目标生成和原子动作执行来缓解长程目标漂移。
highlights.innovation: 高低层 agent 训练方式不同(SFT vs offline-to-online RL),让长程控制更稳;并填补了分层决策训练/评估 benchmark 的空白。
highlights.method: 高层 System 1 用 SFT 学子目标生成;低层 System 2 用 offline-to-online RL 在交互环境里执行原子动作;两层协作完成长程任务。
highlights.results: 在多种交互环境一致超过强 agentic baseline;释放三个分层 benchmark 数据集。
